messages:
marco: Hey all, first-day hiccup. I accepted the org invite and set up 2FA, but when I try to access private repos I get a 403 and a banner saying I need to enable SSO + 2FA. I did enable 2FA though. Any quick checks?

it-bot: Org policy requires SAML SSO + 2FA. If you just enabled 2FA you may need to re-authorize the org: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso :robot_face:

kate: welcome @marco! do you see the "Authorize" banner on the org page? also confirm the email on your GH account is the work one and verified.

marco: I clicked Authorize, email is marco@redwood.com and verified. `gh auth status` shows logged in but the git permission line says permission: none for the repo I need.

infra: that often means SSO accepted but team membership hasn't synced yet (short race). I'll trigger a manual sync and add you to the onboarding team. sign out of browser and sign back in after a minute.

marco: I tried cloning and got `Permission denied (publickey)`. I added my SSH key earlier — could that be a different key?

security: quick test: run `ssh -T git@github.com` and check the username GH reports. If it shows your account name that's the right key. If not, re-upload the correct pubkey.

marco: `ssh -T` -> "Hi marco! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." so SSH key matches. Trying clone again after the sync.

infra: forced sync completed and added you to `onboarding` team. If clone still fails, share the `ssh -v` debug output.

marco: clone worked after the sync. `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/quickstart.git` succeeded. Thanks for the speedy help! :tada:

kate: great — short onboarding checklist we recommend: 1) verify work email, 2) enable 2FA, 3) add SSH key, 4) sign out/in, 5) click org SSO authorize, 6) wait ~30s for permission sync. If anything still fails ping #new-hires.

marco: saved, will add a note to my onboarding doc. Appreciate it everyone :thumbsup:
